policy: Both competing effective configurations must agree on the sign of static final-board evaluation; official outcomes and original reports retained. Inconclusive outcomes excluded from alternative decided-game fraction.

runs.policy: Both competing static weighted scores from player-zero perspective must have the same strict nonzero sign. Proof/tree search disabled. Official outcomes preserved; unfinished and cancelled nonempty legal prefixes eligible. Other failures excluded. Inconclusive games excluded from decided fraction; also show conservative wins/scheduled.
